text:
ella: Quick preflight — webinar in 72hrs: 'Live Lab: Cost-Optimized LLM Inference' (2024-04-05 1pm PT). Final checklist for registration page, Zoom, recording, and lead routing pls.
omar: Quick Q — what's the replay flow? immediate email with clip + full recording?
jules: Propose: immediate 1-min highlight clip within 1hr, full cloud recording + transcript link in email with 24h delay so we can edit captions.
sam_ops: Zoom setup done: cloud recording enabled, separate audio/computer files, auto-transcript ON, host = @ella, co-host = @omar, registration required. I've pinned the meeting ID.
zoombot: Recording started automatically when host joined the meeting.
ella: tagging @jules to own clip edits + caption QA. Can you produce the 1-min highlight by 1hr after end?
jules: yes. Will export 1080p mp4, srt captions, and one 60s trimmed clip. Upload to GCS path: gs://redwood-marketing/webinars/live-lab/2024-04-05/
omar: routing: HubSpot needs sync. Zapier mapping we discussed: attend_time, registration_email, utm_campaign, session_duration -> set property lead_score_increment. Also tag leads: "webinar_live_lab_apr24" and "attended_>20m" for hot leads.
sam_ops: putting the Zap payload here (JSON snippet):
```
{
  "email": "{{registration.email}}",
  "utm_campaign": "live_lab_apr24",
  "attended_seconds": "{{attendee.total_seconds}}",
  "lead_tags": ["webinar_live_lab_apr24"]
}
```
ella: good. Add a rule: if attended_seconds >= 1200 then also add tag "hot_webinar_lead" and route to sales@redwood.com + Slack #sales-inbox via webhook.
omar: can we capture Qs and map to CR? We'll export Q&A CSV from Zoom and attach to HubSpot activity.
jules: caption edits — will clean transcript and upload corrected srt to GCS + link in email. Also generate short text highlights for LinkedIn post.
sam_ops: reminder: set Zoom cloud retention 90 days and enable auto-delete after export to GCS (compliance). Also enable SRT export with timestamps.
ella: email cadence post event:
- 0–1hr: confirmation to attendees "Thanks — clip" (1-min)
- 24hr: full recording + transcript + CTAs (trial link + demo booking)
- 72hr: follow-up to non-attendees w/ key highlights
Make sure replaceable tokens: {{first_name}}, {{company}}, {{session_link}}, {{highlight_clip}}.
omar: adding UTMs: utm_source=webinar, utm_medium=email, utm_campaign=live_lab_apr24, utm_content=full_recording
sam_ops: who owns the post-event segmentation export? @ella
ella: I'll own it. Also, create a "replay-access" page that requires opt-in for marketing nurture (GDPR ok). Use checkbox: "I'd like to receive product updates and event replays." 
jules: timeline: 0-1hr clip ready, 1-6hr upload + initial email, 24hr full edit + transcript, 48-72hr social assets.
omar: sales handoff playbook (short):
1) Attach HubSpot lead with tag hot_webinar_lead
2) If lead_score > 50 -> SDR queue immediate ping in #sales-inbox
3) Otherwise add to 2-week nurture cadence.
ella: small ask — enable auto Slack alert to #marketing when first 10 hot leads come in. Sam can you add a Zap for that?
sam_ops: will add Zap: when HubSpot property "hot_webinar_lead" added -> post to #marketing with CSV of lead names + session_duration. ETA 4hrs.
zoombot: Cloud recording upload completed: /zoom/cloud/recordings/2024-04-05-live_lab.zip
jules: grabbing files now.
omar: tiny tweak: in the registration page, add optional field "Which inference pain point do you want solved?" with radio options. Map answers to HubSpot property "inference_pain_point".
ella: good idea. Also add hidden field: token_source=website and track referring campaign.
sam_ops: double-check: captions provider for social clips = Rev.ai? or internal? Jules?
jules: we'll do internal edit then run Rev.ai for caption polishing if needed. Budget ok.
ella: copy for the immediate clip email (short):
"Thanks for joining Live Lab! Here's a 60s highlight to share: {{highlight_clip}}. We'll send the full recording tomorrow."
omar: crontab for sending immediate email set to trigger when file appears in GCS path.
sam_ops: done. Also enabling checksum verification after upload so we don't send broken links.
ella: anything else? if not, I'll close this thread and turn checklist into Asana tasks.
omar: all good from my side :thumbsup: 
jules: 👍
sam_ops: done, adding Asana tasks now.
